summary: Checks whether a value is a string.
description: The test is `typeof value === "string"`, so the empty string passes and a `String` object, being an object, does not.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).
returns: `true` when the value is a string; otherwise `false`.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
isString(""); // => true
isString("abc"); // => true
isString(1); // => false
isString(null); // => false
isString([]); // => false
```
